items.title: Strong acids aur strong bases ke salts (print mein doosra 9.8.1) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Salts of Strong Acids and Strong Bases, printed as a second 9.8.1 on page 204.

blocks.text: Strong acid aur strong base se bane salts (jaise sodium chloride, NaCl) mein strong acid ka conjugate base (HCl se Cl⁻) bohat kamzor hota hai aur pani se khaas react nahi karta. Strong base ka conjugate acid (NaOH se Na⁺) bhi bohat kamzor hai aur pani se khaas react nahi karta.
Na⁺ strong base NaOH ka conjugate acid hai aur pH par asar nahi karta.
Cl⁻ strong acid HCl ka conjugate base hai aur pH par asar nahi karta.
Is liye solution neutral rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Potassium nitrate (KNO₃) ka solution acidic, basic ya neutral hoga? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Neutral. K⁺ strong base KOH ka conjugate acid hai aur NO₃⁻ strong acid HNO₃ ka conjugate base; dono pani se react karne ke liye bohat kamzor hain, is liye na H₃O⁺ banta hai na OH⁻.

items: Strong acid + strong base ka salt (NaCl): koi ion hydrolyse nahi hota; solution neutral.
